title: Prefix of a permuted path
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\pi$ be a permutation of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $k\in\{0,\ldots,n\}$. The maximal path prefix at $k$ is the set of indices $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ for which $\pi(i)<k$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a permutation of the $n$ indices
$k$ is an integer index from $0$ through $n$, inclusive
